# Logo Data URIs (for artifacts and single-file HTML)

Artifacts and other sandboxed HTML pages cannot load images from external
hosts, so the logo must be embedded. Both files below are the originals served
by 917ventures.com (see [../brand/logo-and-assets.md](../brand/logo-and-assets.md)),
base64-encoded without modification. Copy the full `data:` string into an
`<img src="…">`; do not re-encode, crop or recolor.

Usage rules are in [../brand/logo-and-assets.md](../brand/logo-and-assets.md#logo-usage-rules):
white or `#FAFBFF` background only, or inside a white 8–12px-radius container on
dark surfaces; `alt="917Ventures"`.

## Horizontal logo (964 × 184 PNG, transparent) — headers, report covers

Render at 135–240px wide (`width="160" height="31"` keeps the ratio).

```
data:image/png;base64,
```

## Square mark (512 × 512 PNG, white background) — favicons, avatars, compact headers

Render at 24–48px.

```
data:image/png;base64,
```
